decision: gate offloads test and bundle to the owner's instabox machine dof; no keep-alive
why: owner offered a 4vCPU/8GB box; workerd tests are the heaviest local load. An exec wakes an auto-paused box, and a keep-alive would only reach the free plan's 8 h run cap and its 5-20 min cooldown
evidence: forced gate: test 11.3s on box, 0.18s local CPU (was 9s); a deliberately failing test reports fail and exits 1; a broken sync fell back to local and passed
result: kept; key in ~/.config/xin/instabox.env (600), never synced, never in briefs; XIN_LIVE stays local

decision: subrequest risk: keep the 10x30 stress test in one invocation, no alarm slicing yet
why: spec 01 flagged the per-invocation subrequest cap as a risk to verify in M0
evidence: 10 conversations x 30 fetching tool calls pass in one runInDurableObject; a temporary 10x110 (1100 fetches) probe also passed locally in 18.8s
result: kept; local workerd does not enforce the production cap, so the deployed number is still unproven and noted in 01-host.md risks

decision: gate box pool: dof, xin-b2, xin-b3 run test/bundle in parallel with leases; 4th key unused
why: owner gave 3 more instabox keys. Free plan is 1 machine per account. The 4th account (machine t3dev) answers subscription_required, so it cannot run
evidence: 3 jobs submitted together ran on 3 boxes, 15s wall time; status showed two busy leases at once
result: kept; failing box benched 10 min then next box or local under flock; keys in ~/.config/xin/boxes.env (600)
